items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and preserve the current containment-only plan. Reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row is not site-attributable; $0 site-attributed income does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align; AI-cost records conflict ($881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls); infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are absent or incomplete. Traffic, impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, rankings, ordered items, performance scores, and AI usage are not financial returns. Continue only existing repair-or-close, validation, rollback, deduplication, period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Retain the three opportunities as deferred backlog only; do not requeue or spend. Minimum measurement needed: period-aligned site/content revenue with verified tracking IDs, AI/infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing costs, approved budget records, experiment incremental cost, and predefined learning outcomes.
